dedupe_keys.name: ejes de las carreteras de titularidad provincial

description: Ejes de las carreteras de titularidad provincial is a dataset listed in Diputació de Castelló open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Diputación Provincial de Castelló/Castellón. This dataset is linked to the following visualization: Visualization - Ejes de las carreteras de titularidad provincial Ejes que definen los trazados de las carreteras de titularidad provincial. Este dataset fue creado el 21 de mayo de 2021. Coverage: Province of Castellón. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are movilidad, carretera. The portal shows 320 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-05-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datosabiertos-dipcas-es-portal.
